context: Evaluates correct usage of the spprof profile() decorator. The candidate must apply profile() with proper parameters, verify the decorated function's return value is preserved, and confirm the output file is written and the function name is preserved via functools.wraps.

checklist.name: Decorator applied correctly
checklist.description: Uses @spprof.profile(...) or @profile(...) as a decorator on the compute function with interval_ms=1.

checklist.name: output_path parameter used
checklist.description: Passes output_path='compute_profile.json' (or equivalent) to the profile() decorator.

checklist.name: Return value preserved
checklist.description: Calls the decorated function and verifies the return value is correct (n*(n-1)//2 for n=500000).

checklist.name: Output file created
checklist.description: Verifies that compute_profile.json (or the configured output_path) exists after the decorated function returns.

checklist.name: Function name preserved
checklist.description: Verifies the decorated function's __name__ attribute is 'compute', confirming functools.wraps behavior.
